sql:
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy 
FROM climate 
WHERE avail_season = 6 
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC 
LIMIT 5

SELECT ts_doy, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 1) as avg_temp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 85
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 60 AND 91
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100
